UGA.note: Hospital registration centres are NIRA's; no exchange with a civil register is stated.

facts.fact: NIRA says 28.5 million people were registered under the old system, about 55% of Uganda's 51.4 million (computed from the population held), and 21.4 million had been migrated to the new system.

systems.system: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) new ID system

facts.fact: NIRA says about 636,000 children have been enrolled and it has registration centres in most major hospitals where parents register newborns.

systems.system: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) new ID system

facts.fact: NIRA, the national authority, is migrating records to the new system and operates more than 140 offices, per its manager for monitoring and evaluation.

systems.system: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) new ID system

facts.fact: NIRA says 21.4 million records have moved to the new system, with 6.1 million new entrants registered and cards renewed and printed.
